---
title: "check-code-fold.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that fails when a pull request adds `#| code-fold: false`
to an executed code chunk.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-11-05) is that every executed chunk is
`show` when the prose mentions the code, or `true` when it does not.
`false` removes the fold toggle and gains nothing,
because `show` also keeps the code and its output together.

The check reads the option lines at the top of each chunk
whose fence names an engine, such as `{r}`, `{python}`, or `{julia}`.
A plain fence has no options, and a `code-fold` key in front matter is not examined.

An untouched chunk is never reflagged.
With no base ref the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree;
`whole-tree` measures a corpus.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-code-fold.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-code-fold.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every chunk, not only a PR's additions |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |
